From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:43:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: p95 latency spike for model-sigma v2.3 in production

Quick diagnostic: we see elevated tail behavior on v2.3 for sequence lengths > 512 in the us-east pool. Kernel probe shows a fallback to slower matmul path on ~12% of requests (likely the new fused attention path failing for some shard sizes). KV cache hit rates are normal.

Comparing v2.2 -> v2.3 differences: v2.3 enabled a different attention kernel and slight quantization tuning. We can button rollback to v2.2 image (and revert the kernel flag) with an automated canary then full traffic shift. Expected visible improvement: p95 back down to ~230-260ms based on our canary runs. Risk: a brief (<90s) rolling restart per serving node; we schedule canary in us-east first.

Recommend: approve rollback to v2.2 for us-east only, monitor for 30m, then decide on global rollback. I'll prepare the canary job. Need ops approval to execute.

Karthik
SRE - Inference Runtime

Acknowledged. Operational notes:
- Rollback steps documented in runbook: https://redwood-internal.kb/runbooks/model-rollback
- Pre-checks: capacity reserve at 20% in us-east (OK), health-check grace period set to 3m.
- Impact: rolling restart per serving host; traffic will be rebalanced to variant v2.2 during restart windows. Expect transient 503s for <2% of requests if a host restarts while in-flight.
- Approval matrix: Need written approval from Account Owner or above to initiate (for clients with SLA carveouts).

Request: Naomi — can you confirm account approval for immediate rollback to v2.2? If yes, I will open PS-9231, run the canary (50 rps) and provide live dashboards.

Monica Patel

Monica — please proceed with PS-9231 and keep this thread updated. Karthik — please stand by to revert the attention kernel flags if the canary does not behave as predicted.
